verses.text: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.
verses.textZh: 在耶路撒冷作王、大衛的兒子、傳道者的言語。

verses.text: 'Vanity of vanities,' says the Preacher, 'Vanity of vanities! All is vanity.'
verses.textZh: 傳道者說：虛空的虛空，虛空的虛空，凡事都是虛空。

verses.text: What advantage does man have in all his work Which he does under the sun?
verses.textZh: 人一切的勞碌，就是他在日光之下的勞碌，有甚麼益處呢？

verses.text: A generation goes and a generation comes, But the earth remains forever.
verses.textZh: 一代過去，一代又來，地卻永遠長存。

verses.text: Also, the sun rises and the sun sets; And hastening to its place it rises there [again].
verses.textZh: 日頭出來，日頭落下，急歸所出之地。

verses.text: Blowing toward the south, Then turning toward the north, The wind continues swirling along; And on its circular courses the wind returns.
verses.textZh: 風往南颳，又向北轉，不住地旋轉，而且返回轉行原道。

verses.text: All the rivers flow into the sea, Yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, There they flow again.
verses.textZh: 江河都往海裡流，海卻不滿；江河從何處流，仍歸還何處。

verses.text: All things are wearisome; Man is not able to tell [it]. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, Nor is the ear filled with hearing.
verses.textZh: 萬事令人厭煩（或譯：萬物滿有困乏），人不能說盡。眼看，看不飽；耳聽，聽不足。

verses.text: That which has been is that which will be, And that which has been done is that which will be done. So there is nothing new under the sun.
verses.textZh: 已有的事後必再有；已行的事後必再行。日光之下並無新事。

verses.text: Is there anything of which one might say, 'See this, it is new '? Already it has existed for ages Which were before us.
verses.textZh: 豈有一件事人能指著說這是新的？哪知，在我們以前的世代早已有了。

verses.text: There is no remembrance of earlier things; And also of the later things which will occur, There will be for them no remembrance Among those who will come later [still].
verses.textZh: 已過的世代，無人記念；將來的世代，後來的人也不記念。

verses.text: I, the Preacher, have been king over Israel in Jerusalem.
verses.textZh: 我傳道者在耶路撒冷作過以色列的王。

verses.text: And I set my mind to seek and explore by wisdom concerning all that has been done under heaven. [It] is a grievous task [which] God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
verses.textZh: 我專心用智慧尋求、查究天下所做的一切事，乃知神叫世人所經練的是極重的勞苦。

verses.text: I have seen all the works which have been done under the sun, and behold, all is vanity and striving after wind.
verses.textZh: 我見日光之下所做的一切事，都是虛空，都是捕風。

verses.text: What is crooked cannot be straightened and what is lacking cannot be counted.
verses.textZh: 彎曲的，不能變直；缺少的，不能足數。

verses.text: I said to myself, 'Behold, I have magnified and increased wisdom more than all who were over Jerusalem before me; and my mind has observed a wealth of wisdom and knowledge.'
verses.textZh: 我心裡議論說：我得了大智慧，勝過我以前在耶路撒冷的眾人，而且我心中多經歷智慧和知識的事。

verses.text: And I set my mind to know wisdom and to know madness and folly; I realized that this also is striving after wind.
verses.textZh: 我又專心察明智慧、狂妄，和愚昧，乃知這也是捕風。

verses.text: Because in much wisdom there is much grief, and increasing knowledge [results in] increasing pain.
verses.textZh: 因為多有智慧，就多有愁煩；加增知識的，就加增憂傷。
